description_json.name: Vigenere Cipher with Fixed Key KEY
description_json.idea: A polyalphabetic substitution cipher using a repeating fixed key 'KEY'. Each letter of the plaintext is shifted by the corresponding letter of the key 'KEY' (K=10, E=4, Y=24). Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: For each alphabetic character in the plaintext, shift it forward in the alphabet by the shift value of the current key character. The key 'KEY' repeats cyclically (K=10, E=4, Y=24). Only alphabetic characters advance the key pointer. For uppercase letters: C = (P - 'A' + shift) % 26 + 'A'. For lowercase letters: c = (p - 'a' + shift) % 26 + 'a'. Non-alphabetic characters are copied directly to the ciphertext without advancing the key pointer.
description_json.decrypt_rules: For each alphabetic character in the ciphertext, shift it backward in the alphabet by the shift value of the current key character. The key 'KEY' repeats cyclically (K=10, E=4, Y=24). Only alphabetic characters advance the key pointer. For uppercase letters: P = (C - 'A' - shift + 26) % 26 + 'A'. For lowercase letters: p = (c - 'a' - shift + 26) % 26 + 'a'. Non-alphabetic characters are copied directly to the plaintext without advancing the key pointer.

description_json.name: QWERTY monoalphabetic substitution cipher
description_json.idea: A fixed one-to-one substitution over the English alphabet. Each plaintext letter is replaced by exactly one ciphertext letter using a single bijection, and the mapping is the same for uppercase and lowercase letters. Non-letter characters are left unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Use the following bijection: plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -> ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm. Thus a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t, f->y, g->u, h->i, i->o, j->p, k->a, l->s, m->d, n->f, o->g, p->h, q->j, r->k, s->l, t->z, u->x, v->c, w->v, x->b, y->n, z->m. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Use the inverse bijection: ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm -> plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz. Thus q->a, w->b, e->c, r->d, t->e, y->f, u->g, i->h, o->i, p->j, a->k, s->l, d->m, f->n, g->o, h->p, j->q, k->r, l->s, z->t, x->u, c->v, v->w, b->x, n->y, m->z. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
